1.b4 e6 2.Bb2 Nf6 3.b5 a6 4.a4 axb5 5.ax.strategy: Recaptures so that the pawn stays on b5, still cramping Black's queenside, and leaves the rooks staring at each other down the open file. White keeps the space, but the pawn on b5 now has no pawn to support it.
Trades off the rooks on the open file before White can use it; the bishop recaptures, so the trade is even and the file is left empty.
